Title: Some admins may see outdated device inventory and update status information in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center

User impact: Admins may see outdated device inventory and update status information in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

More info: Device updates are continuing as expected, but the reported status and insights may not reflect the latest device state.

Current status: We’ve been alerted through our internal monitors and a subset of affected users to an issue in which admins may see outdated device inventory and update status information in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center. We’re reviewing service health telemetry specific to when impact first occurred so that we can refine our understanding of how impact arose, which we anticipate will help ascertain our next troubleshooting actions.

Scope of impact: Admins attempting to view device inventory and update status information in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center may be affected. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Thursday, August 20, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC

Next update by: Sunday, August 23, 2026, at 9:00 PM UTC
